role: causal announcement interface for a distinct public-receipt-driven simulation task
registration_context: all eight advance-notice component paths observed safe; no translated announcement ledger, announced-task controller or announced-task performance result has been generated

contract.service: deliver fixed absolute common-direction pulses under an advance-announced simulation schedule, executing locked PN outside pulses
contract.lead_rationale: the diagnosed information cutoff is 90 minutes before a call; 120 minutes is the smallest whole-hour lead meeting it while retaining the existing hourly delivery grid. No notice-duration search
contract.generation: at each original clock t use its cached receipt-prefix mark, whose selected public source has already arrived by t, to issue a binding announcement for delivery at t+120
contract.locking: announced direction and fixed peak remain unchanged after release; later public receipts generate their own later announcements
contract.inactive_announcements: an empty original mark publishes no activation for that future slot; it remains in the announced clock roster and creates no delivered request
contract.warmup: no service calls at minutes 0 and 60; these two startup slots are part of the defined task, with no invented negative-time announcements
contract.pulse: one-minute linear ramp from the locked reference, 30-minute absolute hold, one-minute return to the locked reference at minute 32, then resume reference
contract.physical_model: retain the original per-unit 98 MWh inventories, 98 MW shared gross limit, 0.92 efficiencies, 30-minute PN clock and 60-minute PN lead
contract.future_controller_inputs: own state and commitments plus announcements whose release_minute is no later than the current decision; unreleased requests stay outside the controller interface
contract.service_accounting: all 95 activated requests remain obligations; partial or rejected pulses remain failures, while inactive and warmup slots create no successful service observations
contract.comparison_scope: future controller comparisons share this announced task and its 170-hour execution horizon

interface_preflight.outputs: compact 168-row announcement ledger, 170-row delivery clock roster and summary; no minute physics or prices
required_checks: preserve all original direction/source pairs and the 95 activations, with only delivery shifted by 120 minutes
every selected public source is received no later than its announcement release
announcement prefixes exposed at a decision include only released rows; changes to unreleased rows leave that prefix unchanged
every announced call is visible by its delivery-minus-90 critical nomination cutoff, and bootstrap slots are explicit
interface_preflight.storage: JSON only; reuse cached local inputs

decision: resolve any announcement-accounting or visibility discrepancy first; after interface success, specify and freeze a bounded announced-task controller component preflight before any weekly rollout. No matrix or source comparison starts automatically
preservation: write a separate announced-task ledger; retain all original timestamps, request histories, information schedules and negative results
limitations: analyst-defined announced service, developed after inspecting prior failures; not historical BM counterfactual dispatch or documented BOA notice. Interface success does not establish full-week feasibility, 95-percent development reliability, source benefit or OR submission readiness
